counterfactual.change: Increased controller fmax from 81.179 to 200 (single field change). Same kp/vcmd/waypoint/seed, commanded force ~105.5 is now within limit, so no violation - proves failure is missing force clamping to fmax.

explanation: Controller violates fmax at step 1: force 105.53 > limit 81.179. With kp=28.6 and vcmd=4.41 toward waypoint (16.5,3.6) from (14.2,11), desired velocity magnitude is 4.41, so kp*velocity_error ≈126 before noise, exceeding fmax. The controller does not clamp the commanded force to fmax (noise 0.219 added, still >limit). Counterfactual raising fmax to 200 eliminates violation with same dynamics, confirming missing/incorrect clamping.
vision_note: The red controller body sits near the top center far southeast of the green waypoint in the lower right. Between step 0 and step 1 it shows almost no displacement, consistent with an instantaneous force-limit violation at startup rather than a visible jump or wall penetration.
